info.title: Yadeit API
info.description: Yadeit: projects, work items, comments and attachments. The web app signs in with a cookie session; scripts and agents send a bearer token. Work items are addressed by key (for example WEB-143). Errors always have the shape {"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}.

delete.summary: Removes the agent from the workspace and revokes all its tokens. Its past activity stays attributed to it

projects.description: null means every project of the workspace.

post.summary:
Creates a token. The secret is returned once, in `token`, and cannot be
read again: store it where the agent runs

projects.description: null means every project of the workspace.

get.summary: Whether AI is on and usable here, and how much of the month's allowance is used

monthly_token_limit.description: The plan caps the allowance when the installation pays for the tokens.

put.summary:
Admins switch AI on or off, set the workspace's own provider key
(`api_key: null` goes back to the instance's key) and its monthly token
limit. The key is write-only: it is never returned

monthly_token_limit.description: The plan caps the allowance when the installation pays for the tokens.

post.summary: Drafts a work item from one sentence: title, description, kind, priority, labels and acceptance criteria
Summarises a page: a few sentences and its key points

Suggests what to do with a piece of feedback: whether it duplicates
other feedback in the inbox, whether an open item already covers it,
and the kind, priority and labels a new item would get
Proposes sub-items that together cover the item. An empty list means it is small enough as it is
Summarises an item and its discussion: where it stands, what was decided, what is still open

get.summary: Filters: action (prefix, e.g. "member." or "token.created"), actor (member id). Newest first
The plan with its limits and the current usage. For admins and owners

limits_enforced.description: Off on installations without paid plans: the limits are then shown nowhere and refuse nothing.

members.description: People only, open invitations included: an agent is not a seat.

ends_at.description: Set when the plan was cancelled and runs until this date.

post.summary: Starts buying a plan: answers with the address of the payment page. Owners only

get.summary:
Filters: project (key), state (name or id), state_group, priority, kind,
assignee (id, "me" or "none"), delegate (agent id, "me" or "none"),
needs_input (true = waiting for a person's answer),
cycle ("current", "none" or a cycle number; use with project),
blocked (true = an open item must be finished first),
demand (true = at least one piece of feedback asks for it), label (name), parent (key or "none"),
q (text in the title, or an exact key), open (true hides closed items).
Paging: limit (default 25, max 100) and cursor. Shaping: expand, fields

delegate.description: The agent doing the work; the assignee stays the accountable person.

demand.description: How many pieces of feedback ask for this item.

get.summary:
Work that can be started right now, most urgent first: not started,
not blocked by an open item, and free to take. An agent sees items
delegated to it plus items nobody holds; a person sees items assigned
to them plus items nobody holds. Take one with POST items/{key}/claim

delegate.description: The agent doing the work; the assignee stays the accountable person.

demand.description: How many pieces of feedback ask for this item.

patch.summary:
Send the version you last saw as `expected_version` (or If-Match) to
avoid overwriting someone else's change; a mismatch answers 412

delete.summary: A soft delete: the item disappears from lists but its number is never reused

token.description: The access token the change came through; null for the web app.

post.summary:
Takes the item to work on. Exactly one of several simultaneous callers
succeeds; the others get 409 `already_claimed`. Claiming again when you
already hold it changes nothing

delete.summary: Gives the item back so that someone else can take it

post.summary:
Asks a person a question and marks the item as waiting for input. The
flag clears by itself when a person replies in the comments

get.summary: The log of every agent run on the item, newest run first, each with its entries in order

stale.description: Still marked active, but silent for a while: the agent may have crashed.

post.summary:
For agents: notes progress on an item you hold. `thought` for a plan or
reasoning, `action` for something done, `error` when you cannot go on
(this ends the run as failed). Use ask for questions and
submit-for-review for the result. Log meaningful steps, not every command

stale.description: Still marked active, but silent for a while: the agent may have crashed.

post.summary: Hands the work to a person for review, with an optional summary posted as a comment
